paragraphs.zh:
Die Schmelzpunkte wurden mittels DSC (Pyris 1 der Fa. Perkin Elmer, Heizrate 10 K min-1ermittelt. Zur Bestimmung der Raman-Spektren wurden mittels eines RFS 100/S FT-Raman der Fa. Bruker von jeder Partie mindestens zwei Spektren mit jeweils 128 Scans aufgenommen. Die Infrarot-Spektren wurden mit einem FT-IR-Spektrometer (Fa. Bruker Tensor 37) mit jeweils 64 Scans aufgenommen.
Die Feststoffdichte wurde nach der Dichtebestimmungsmethode SOP 5024 mit dem Ultrapyknometer 1000 T der Fa. Quanta-Chrome bestimmt bzw. aus der Einkristallröntgenstrukturanalyse (EKS) ermittelt. Die Einkristallröntgenstrukturanalyse wurde durch Verwendung einer Drehanode M18X-HF mit MoKα-Strahlung von MACScience Co und einen SMART-CCD-1000-Detektor von Bruker-AXS bestimmt. Die Daten wurden mit den Programmen SAINT-NT V 5.0 (Datenreduktion, Bruker-AXS) und SADABS (Absorptionskorrektur, Bruker-AXS) bearbeitet. Die Strukturlösung und Verfeinerung wurde mit SHELXTL NT-Version V5.1 durchgeführt.
paragraphs.en:
The melting points were determined by means of DSC (Pyris 1 from Perkin Elmer, heating rate 10 K min-1determined. For the determination of the Raman spectra, at least two spectra of 128 scans each were recorded from every batch by means of an RFS 100/S FT-Raman from Bruker. The infrared spectra were recorded on an FT-IR spectrometer (Bruker Tensor 37) with 64 scans each.
The solid density was determined by the density determination method SOP 5024 with the Ultrapyknometer 1000 T from Quanta-Chrome, or was obtained from the single-crystal X-ray structure analysis (EKS). The single-crystal X-ray structure analysis was carried out using an M18X-HF rotating anode with MoKα radiation from MACScience Co and a SMART-CCD-1000 detector from Bruker-AXS. The data were processed with the programs SAINT-NT V 5.0 (data reduction, Bruker-AXS) and SADABS (absorption correction, Bruker-AXS). The structure solution and refinement was carried out with SHELXTL NT version V5.1.
paragraphs.notes: Transcribed as printed, including two faults in the patent's own typesetting in the first sentence: the bracket opened at '(Pyris 1' is never closed, and the printed string is 'Heizrate 10 K min-1ermittelt' with no space between the superscript -1 and 'ermittelt', which also leaves the sentence with two finite constructions ('wurden mittels DSC ... ermittelt' around an un-closed parenthesis). These are the patent's errors, not transcription errors, and were verified on the page image at high magnification as well as in the text layer. The unit is printed as 'min' with a superscript -1 and is recorded as 'min-1' the way the briefing directs for 'cm-1'. This paragraph is printed as two blocks: the second block, beginning 'Die Feststoffdichte', starts on a new line under the same [0019] marker and carries no marker of its own; the line break between them is preserved here as a newline. Line-break hyphens repaired when reassembling: 'Be-stimmung' to 'Bestimmung', 'Einkristallroentgenstruk-turanalyse' to 'Einkristallroentgenstrukturanalyse', '(Da-tenreduktion' to '(Datenreduktion', 'Ver-feinerung' to 'Verfeinerung'. Hyphens kept because they are real: Raman-Spektren, FT-Raman, Infrarot-Spektren, FT-IR-Spektrometer, Quanta-Chrome, M18X-HF, MoKalpha-Strahlung, SMART-CCD-1000-Detektor, Bruker-AXS, SAINT-NT, NT-Version. Every instrument name, model number and parameter is transcribed verbatim and none was normalised: DSC Pyris 1 (Perkin Elmer), 10 K min-1; FT-Raman RFS 100/S (Bruker), at least 2 spectra of 128 scans per batch; FT-IR Bruker Tensor 37, 64 scans; density method SOP 5024, Ultrapyknometer 1000 T (Quanta-Chrome); rotating anode M18X-HF, MoKalpha, MACScience Co; detector SMART-CCD-1000 (Bruker-AXS); software SAINT-NT V 5.0 and SADABS (Bruker-AXS), SHELXTL NT-Version V5.1. Note that the page prints 'Ultrapyknometer 1000 T der Fa. Quanta-Chrome', not 'Quanta-Chrome Ultrapyknometer', and 'SHELXTL NT-Version V5.1', not 'SHELXTL NT V5.1'.
Section heading printed on its own line above [0020], with no [00NN] marker of its own. Marks the start of the preparation part of the description.

paragraphs.zh: Tembotrione an sich kann beispielsweise nach einem der in WO 00/21924 genannten Verfahren hergestellt werden. In Abhängigkeit von der Art des im letzten Reinigungsschritt verwendeten Lösungsmittels und der Temperaturführung kristallisiert Tembotrione üblicherweise als Gemisch oder in Form einer reinen der hier beschriebenen metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen II und III aus.
paragraphs.en: Tembotrione as such can be prepared, for example, by one of the processes named in WO 00/21924. Depending on the nature of the solvent used in the last purification step and on the temperature regime, tembotrione usually crystallises out as a mixture or in the form of a pure one of the metastable crystal modifications II and III described here.
paragraphs.notes: The preparation of tembotrione itself is NOT described in this patent; it is given only by reference to WO 00/21924. Line-break hyphens repaired: 'Tempera-turfuehrung' to 'Temperaturfuehrung' and 'me-tastabilen' to 'metastabilen'. 'in Form einer reinen der hier beschriebenen metastabilen Kristallmodifikationen II und III' is grammatically defective German as printed (a noun is missing after 'einer reinen'); translated literally rather than repaired, per the pass rules.

paragraphs.zh: Die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione kann in allgemeiner Weise so hergestellt
paragraphs.en: The thermodynamically stable crystal modification I of tembotrione can in a general manner be so prepared
paragraphs.notes: Paragraph [0021] begins on this page and is cut off mid-sentence at the foot of the page; the last printed word on page 7 is 'hergestellt'. It continues at the top of page 8 with 'werden, dass man die nach WO 00/21924 erhaeltliche Kristallmodifikation II und III ... bei Temperaturen von 0 Grad C bis 80 Grad C behandelt.' Only the text printed on page 7 is recorded here; the continuation is left to the page 8 read so that no text is duplicated across two pages. The English rendering is correspondingly a fragment and reads awkwardly because the German verb frame is not closed until page 8.

discrepancies.what: Tabelle 6 on this page, the X-ray powder pattern of crystal modification II, carries values identical to Tabelle 5 on page 6, the pattern of crystal modification I, digit for digit in all 49 cells. Two different polymorphs cannot have identical powder patterns, so one of the two tables is almost certainly wrong in the published patent. Recorded, not resolved: both readings are transcribed as printed and the disagreement is left visible.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Page 7 image, Tabelle 6, caption 'Kristallmodifikation II': 7.3765, 8.0674, 10.7988 ... 36.4372, 36.7974, 13 rows in 4 columns, read off the page image and confirmed against the page 7 text layer.
discrepancies.text_says: Page 6 text layer, Tabelle 5, caption 'Kristallmodifikation I': the same 49 values in the same order, with the last row carried over to page 7 under '(fortgesetzt)'. I have not seen the page 6 image myself, so the identity is asserted from page 6's extracted text and from the fact that page 7's '(fortgesetzt)' row, 20.4034 / 25.9248 / 31.6675, is also the final row of Tabelle 6 on this page. The page 6 read should confirm or contradict this.

discrepancies.what: The prose of [0019] names two instruments in a word order that a downstream pass could easily normalise into the wrong thing; recorded so the printed form is recoverable.
discrepancies.drawing_says: No drawing on this page; not applicable.
discrepancies.text_says: The page prints 'mit dem Ultrapyknometer 1000 T der Fa. Quanta-Chrome' (the manufacturer follows the model) and 'SHELXTL NT-Version V5.1' (with 'NT-Version', not a bare 'NT'). Both are transcribed exactly and neither was reordered.

notes: Page 7 of 23, description part. Layout top to bottom: the running head 'EP 2 045 236 A1'; a '(fortgesetzt)' one-row table fragment that is the tail of Tabelle 5 from page 6; Tabelle 6 complete in 13 rows; Tabelle 7, the crystallographic data table; the heading 'Beschreibung der Erfindung'; [0019]; the heading 'Herstellung'; [0020]; [0021] cut off mid-sentence at the foot; the page number '7' centred in the footer. Every table's content is carried inside the zh and en of a paragraph entry as a GitHub markdown table, per the briefing, since a table has no representation of its own downstream. Three of the eight paragraph entries carry synthetic markers ('Tabelle 5 (fortgesetzt)', 'Tabelle 6', 'Tabelle 7') because the tables are printed under bare captions with no [00NN] marker, and two more carry the section headings 'Beschreibung der Erfindung' and 'Herstellung' as their markers for the same reason. Column structure for all three tables was read off the page image first and the text layer was used only to confirm digits; every digit matched. THIS PAGE CARRIES NO CHEMICAL STRUCTURE AND NO REACTION SCHEME, so 'drawings' is empty as a finding and not an omission; the whole patent contains exactly one drawn structure, on page 2. Nothing on this page is presented as a synthetic route, so the invention_route / prior_art question does not arise here; [0020] explicitly defers the preparation of tembotrione itself to WO 00/21924 and describes no chemistry. The numerals 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 down the left margin are the EP line-number ruler, a publication artifact, and are not content. Nothing on the page was illegible: it is born digital, and the two passages that look like transcription errors ('min-1ermittelt' with no space and an unclosed bracket in [0019]; 'a = 15,8491 (5) (18) A' with two parenthesised groups in Tabelle 7) were magnified and confirmed against the image, and are the patent's own faults. page_confidence is high on that basis; the identical-tables finding in 'discrepancies' is a fault in the source document, not a limit on how well the page could be read. Note that the 2theta tables use a decimal POINT while Tabelle 7 and the rest of the German text use a decimal COMMA; both are recorded as printed. Vision pass performed by Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]).
blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
